Executable notebooks that demonstrate the full `txtcaptcha` pipeline. The
rendered versions below use cached outputs — to re-run them you need a GPU
machine and the labeled datasets on disk (see
[`download_dataset`](../reference/download_dataset.qmd)).

- **Train unified model** — download every labeled dataset, merge them into
  one folder and fit a single CRNN on the full alphanumeric vocabulary.
- **Evaluate per dataset** — per-source accuracy on a held-out split of the
  training corpus.
- **Evaluate per dataset (live)** — smoke-test the model on freshly
  downloaded, unlabeled captchas to check for overfit.
